I (re)tested on my Mac, and I got this (attached below).

I would suggest to

remove.packages("INLA")

restart R (remove any .RData) and do

source("http://www.math.ntnu.no/inla/givemeINLA.R")

if that does not help, do

download

http://www.math.ntnu.no/inla/binaries/INLA.tgz

and then do

install.packages("INLA.tgz", repos=NULL, type="source")


I hope this helps.

Best,
H

prepacked binaries of the inla-program that is inside the R-INLA
package, you'll need to upgrade your OS. this is because these binaries
are buildt on a machine running the latest MacOSX release.
